item.title: EplayerX 1.2.68
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 改善部分 Dolby Vision HEVC 视频的播放兼容性，修复视频初始化时无法读取必要解码信息的问题。 - 修复缓冲达到上限时，下一段视频尚未就绪可能导致播放卡在加载中的问题。播放器会继续准备缺失的视频段，改善续播和跳转后的恢复。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。
## What’s New
- Improved playback compatibility for some Dolby Vision HEVC videos by recovering decoder configuration from the video stream when opening the file. - Fixed a playback stall that could occur when buffering reached its limit before the next segment was ready. The player now continues preparing the missing segment to help playback recover after a pause or seek.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later.
